summary: ALT5 Sigma Corp filed an 8-K disclosing its acquisition of Block Street Corp. via a Stock Exchange Agreement. ALT5 issued 12,670,257 shares valued at $12 million (at Nasdaq minimum price) to Block Street's four owners and granted two sets of five-year pre-funded warrants: Set One for up to 15,837,821 shares with a $15 million exercise price, vesting upon $20 million net revenue; Set Two for up to 16,893,675 shares with a $16 million exercise price, vesting upon $8 million modified operating income. The board recommendation is not stated; no advisors named. What to watch: Block Street's post-closing revenue generation triggers warrant vesting, creating a risk-arb angle on earnings milestones.
